exercises.name: Forearm Supination and Pronation
instructions: Keep your elbow close to your body.
Rotate your forearm until your palm faces upward (supination).
Rotate your forearm back until your palm faces downward (pronation).
Perform the movement slowly and carefully.
safetyNotes: Do not force movement beyond the prescribed range.
Stop the exercise if pain occurs.
Keep the elbow in a stable position.
